def slugify(s):
    # Transliterate accented characters: NFKD decomposes e.g. 'õ' into
    # 'o' + a combining tilde, then dropping non-ASCII leaves just 'o'.
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)
    s = s.encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode('ascii')
    s = s.lower()
    # Collapse any run of non-alphanumeric characters to a single hyphen,
    # then drop leading/trailing hyphens.
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', s)
    return s.strip('-')
